findings.problem: Every source was read as search-result text; three page fetches failed. Several ABC11 and WRAL summaries were filed under their outlet by inference and are not counted towards corroboration, so many claims are REQUIRES REVIEW.
findings.recommendation: Read in full: WRAL's opening-statement story, the Daily Tar Heel's opening story, CBS News's trial story and ABC11's 2021 arrest and 2014 note stories; record full_text access.

findings.problem: Time-sensitive: the trial is ongoing as of 13 October 2026. When a verdict comes, the opening, the close, the end card and the description are out of date.
findings.recommendation: Publish only while the trial is ongoing, or make a new versioned cut with the verdict, attributed to reporting, and re-run the gate.

findings.problem: Pending trial: the defendant is presumed innocent. He is never drawn; his name card says 'charged · presumed innocent'; every prosecution point is attributed and paired with the defence's answer; the not-guilty plea is stated in the cold open, chapter 5 and the close.
findings.recommendation: Keep the same balance in comments and any Shorts.

findings.problem: The roommate is a State witness and the judge barred the defence from presenting her as an alternative suspect. She is not named in narration, not drawn, and nothing implies suspicion of her; the 2012 'not random' statement and the 2013 profile are attributed to police and the FBI.
findings.evidence: Script and packaging (a title implying suspicion was rejected).

findings.problem: Excluded: injury and autopsy detail beyond the cause of death, sexual-assault forensics, the roommate smudge exchange, the roommate's medical history, all uncharged people, the 2016 DNA composite, the jail warrant, and the note's expletive.
findings.recommendation: Keep them out of packaging and comments.
